DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City wwwdilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 50 s. 2023 July 20, 2023 HON. PEDRO ABALOS MERRERA Ill Mayor Municipal Hall of Binmaley 27H9+CP8, National Road Binmaley, Pangasinan Dear Mayor Merrera Ill: This pertains to your letter dated March 29, 2023 requesting for the Department's opinion on the following, quoted hereunder in toto: 1. 2. 3. 4. Whether or not the Municipal Government of Binmaley can validly allocate funds for additional benefits, subsidy/honorarium of Barangay Health Workers whose main functions are primarily lodged with Barangay Local Government Units? Whether or not a Sangguniang Bayan Member, on his own and without any request from the Office of the Mayor, has the authority to allocate funding for the ordinance providing for additional benefits, subsidy/honorarium of Barangay Health Workers usinq the Special Purpose Appropriation funds under the Office of the Mayor? Whether or not a Sangguniang Bayan Member, through the proposed ordinance, can unilaterally imposed programs and items of appropriations under the Special Appropriationl Purpose funds of the Office of the Mayor? In the event that the said proposed additional benefits, subsidy/honorarium of Barangay Health Workers cannot be validly funded by the Municipal Government under the Special Purpose Allocation of the Mayor, where can the appropriation be charged? Per your representation, the Sangguniang Bayan of Binmaley, Pangasinan intends to pass an ordinance, entitled: "An ordinance Providing Guidelines for the Registration of Binmaley Barangay Health Workers (BHWs); Granting All Qualified BHWs Additional Benefits and Subsidy/Honorarium, Appropriating Funds and For Other Purposes". Pertinent provisions are: (1) Benefits and Incentives of Municipal-Paid BHWs; (2) Honorarium Subsidy for BHWs; (3) Financial Assistance to Retiring BHWs; and (4) Appropriation for the Additional Benefits and Incentives for Qualified BHWs is chargeable against the FY 2024 budget for Special Purpose Appropriation for Program and Projects for Essential Community Services. Thus, the above mentioned queries. At the outset, this Department deems it wise to discuss the foregoing queries into one discussion only as they are interrelated. 1 The Special Purpose Appropriation under the Office of the Mayor consists of: 20% Development Fund, 5% Disaster Risk and Reduction Management (DRRM) Fund and Other Special Purpose Appropriation "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

one of the allowable expenses chargeable against the Special Health Fund is found in Item VI(c)(6) of DOH-DBM-DOF-DILG and PhilHealth Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2021-00012, thus: 6.1ncentives for all health workers, including Barangay Health Workers (BHWs) and Barangay Nutrition Scholars (BNS), within the territorial Jurisdiction of the Provincial/City Health Board (PICHB). Allocation mechanism shall be decided upon by the Health Board. Special Health Fund (SHF) refers to a pool of financial resources at the P/CWHS intended to finance population-based and individual-based health services, health system operating costs, capital investments, and remuneration of additional health workers and incentives for all health workers3. If the Municipal Government of Binmaley would want to utilize the Special Health Fund for the benefit of BHWs, they shall participate in Province/City-Wide Health System (P/CWHS)4. CHWS includes the City Health Office, facilities and services, human resources, and other operations relating to health under the administrative and technical supervision of the City Health Board (CHB), and PHWS includes the Provincial, Component City and Municipal Health Offices, facilities and services, human resources, and other operations relating to health under the administrative and technical supervision of the Provincial Health Board (PHB). The PHB and CHB assumes full responsibility in the management of the SHF, subject to existing pertinent budgeting, accounting and auditing rules and regulations. They shall ensure that the SHF is optimally utilized to help achieve the desirable health outcomes of the population within their respective territorial jurisdiction. Thus, Sangguniang Bayan Member, on his own, has no authority to allocate funding for the ordinance providing for additional benefits, subsidy/hdnorarium of Barangay Health Workers using the SFH. Furthermore, the following shall be observed pursuant to Item VIII of DOH-DBM-DOF- DILG and PhilHealth Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2021-0001, viz: A. In addition to the existing government budgeting, accounting and auditing B. C. 2 Entitled, " rules and regulations, all disbursements from the SHF shall be in accordance with: I. Allowable expenses chargeable against the SHF (Section V.C. of this JMC); 2. The LIPH and AOP; 3. Contractual arrangement between DOH and the PICHB; and 4. Contractual arrangement between PhilHealth and the PICHB; and 5. Contractual arrangement between the CSOIIHP, and PICHB Copy of approved P/CHIB Board Resoltion on the use of the SHF shall be furnished to the Provincial/ City Budget Officer, Treasurer and Accountant as basis for the certification of availability of funds, disbursement and recording. The authorized signing official/s for the disbursement of funds shall be in accordance with the Local Government Code and the UHC Act. GUIDELINES ON THE ALLOCATION, UTILIZATION, AND MONITORING OF, AND ACCOUNTABILITY FOR, THE SPECIAL HEALTH FUND" 3 Item III(R), DOH-DBM-DOF-DILG and PhilHealth Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2021-0001 4 Item IV, DOH-DBM-DOF-DILG and PhilHealth Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2021-0001

"D. Any procurement chargeable against the SHF shall be in accordance with Republic Act No. 9184, otherwise knowns as the "Government Procurement Reform Act", its IRR as amended, Government Procurement Policy Board guidelines and other related issuances. Accordingly, we are of the view that if the fund to be utilized is other than the SHF, the Municipal Government cannot validly allocate funds for additional benefits, subsidy/honorarium of BHWs whose main functions are primarily lodged with Barangay Local Government Units. This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Thank you.
